title: [epic] IPNS publishing — stable addresses for group heads
description:
Why: The current gossipsub tip advertisement tells connected peers about the latest group head CID, but there is no stable, dereferenceable address for the current head of a group. IPNS (InterPlanetary Name System) lets an operator publish a mutable pointer to the current tip CID under a stable key-derived address. Any IPFS client can resolve the group head without knowing this server's address or being connected to gossipsub.

What:
- After each successful pipeline write that advances a group's tip, publish the new tip CID to IPNS under a key derived from the group name and the operator signing key.
- The IPNS record is signed by the operator key (already loaded at startup).
- Expose the IPNS addresses for each group via the admin API and NNTP XCAP or a new XIPNS command.
- Configurable: operators can opt out per-group or globally.
- rust-ipfs 0.15 supports IPNS publish; verify API and wire in.
